name: CSO_ARTICLE_LINKS
description: This table is used to store the article links of knowledge articles.

columns.name: LINK_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references cso_content_text (RECORD_ID), contains version Id of the linked-from article.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document ID of the linked-from article.

columns.name: SOURCE_LOCALE_ID
columns.description: Locale ID of the linked-from article.

columns.name: SOURCE_ANSWER_ID
columns.description: Answer ID of the linked-from article.

columns.name: TARGET_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document ID of the linked-to article.

columns.name: TARGET_LOCALE_ID
columns.description: Locale ID of the linked-to article.

columns.name: TARGET_ANCHOR_ID
columns.description: Anchor ID of the linked-to article.

columns.name: TARGET_ANSWER_ID
columns.description: Answer ID of the linked-to article.
